items.name: Stable Audio 3.0
items.why: 此模型家族提供音樂與音效生成，支援長達六分鐘的音軌、音訊編輯及開放權重模型，適用於多種創作需求。
items.why_en: This model family offers music and sound effect generation, supporting tracks up to six minutes, audio editing, and open-weight models for diverse creative needs.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music v2
items.why: 大幅提升音樂生成能力，具備更佳的人聲、樂器與編曲，支援多語言，並提供音軌內修復與分段創作等進階控制。
items.why_en: Significantly enhances music generation with better vocals, instrumentation, and arrangement, multilingual support, and advanced controls like inpainting and section-by-section composition.

items.name: Magenta RealTime 2
items.why: Google發布的即時音樂生成AI模型，提供DAW插件與樂器應用程式，支援兩種版本，並針對Apple Silicon優化。
items.why_en: Google's real-time music generation AI model, offering DAW plugins and instrument apps, with two versions and optimization for Apple Silicon.

items.name: Woosh
items.why: Sony AI專為音效生成推出的基礎模型，支援文字轉音訊和影像轉音訊，專注於遊戲、電影和互動媒體的專業音效設計。
items.why_en: Sony AI's foundational model for sound effect generation, supporting text-to-audio and video-to-audio, focused on professional SFX design for gaming, film, and interactive media.

items.name: AudioGen
items.why: 透過文字提示生成音效，品質足以用於影片背景音訊和遊戲開發原型，為快速生成SFX提供實用工具。
items.why_en: Generates sound effects from text prompts, with quality suitable for video background audio and game development prototyping, offering a practical tool for quick SFX generation.
